source.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold
source.finding: The paper includes correlated ZZ and swap-like errors from stray interactions during CZ operations. Its detailed simulation also includes leakage and nearest/diagonal-neighbor crosstalk during parallel CZ gates.

local_model_scope: Our100kHz uniform static ZZ model is a defined sensitivity test, not a measured Willow value or a reproduction of the paper. It omits external spectators, diagonal-neighbor interactions, leakage and pulse overlap. The source motivates testing correlated errors but does not validate the assumed rate.
next_experiment: Rank using first-order Markovian/readout output probabilities plus independently checked second-order coherent ZZ coefficients; require no worse nominal surrogate, then test fresh calibrations under full density-matrix models.
